character.name: Rurik Harrow
traits: Butcher's Precision: Can identify structural weak points in any living or dead creature, deals an extra 1d4 damage to surprised targets
Unassuming Neighbor: Appears completely harmless to strangers, gains advantage on Deception checks when posing as a helpful community member
Ritual Trophy Keeper: Collects small, perfectly concealed mementos from each of his victims; no one has ever discovered his collection
Pattern Hunter: Is compelled to complete the 13-victim ritual cycle to fulfill a vow to the old slaughterhouse gods; straying from the pattern causes him great mental anguish
character.gear: Leather armor · Serrated skinning knife · Coarse wool neighbor's cloak · 3 dried meat rations · Bone rune ritual cord · 50 ft hemp rope · Brass tinderbox · Carved wooden pig trinket
character.story: Raised by a reclusive village butcher who taught him that all flesh is equal, Rurik learned early that some deaths are sacred offerings to the old gods of the slaughterhouse. Now a polite, unassuming neighbor who carries firewood for widows and fixes fence posts for free, he stalks his thirteenth victim to complete the ritual pattern the old butcher started. The village guard hunts a wild beast blamed for recent disappearances; no one suspects the quiet young man who always brings extra meat to the town potluck.

inventory.name: Serrated skinning knife
inventory.lore: This small bone-handled knife was issued to Rurik by the old village butcher who raised him, its edge honed on thousands of animal carcasses before it took its first human life twelve years ago.
inventory.description: A small, razor-sharp serrated knife with a polished bone handle, stained dark with old blood that no scrubbing can remove.

inventory.name: Leather armor
inventory.lore: Simple cured leather, worn soft and thin at the elbows from decades of butcher work; it has absorbed the blood of both livestock and the twelve victims Rurik has claimed so far.
inventory.description: Worn brown leather armor, stitched with faint, almost invisible runes of silence woven in by the old butcher to muffle the sound of struggling victims.
inventory.effects: While worn, imposes no disadvantage on Stealth checks.

inventory.name: Healing potion
inventory.lore: Brewed by the village hedge witch from belladonna and rendered fat, Rurik bought it under the guise of treating a stray dog's wound; he keeps it tucked in his boot for hunts that go wrong.
inventory.description: A small vial of thick, crimson liquid that fizzes slightly when the stopper is removed.

inventory.name: Bone rune ritual cord
inventory.lore: Carved from the pinky finger bone of Rurik's first victim, each of the six runes is inscribed with the name of a dark harvest deity the old butcher worshipped in secret.
inventory.description: Six small, polished bone runes strung on a frayed leather cord, warm to the touch like living flesh.
inventory.effects: Can expend 1 charge to cast thaumaturgy (no verbal component) to mark a target as the thirteenth ritual sacrifice; activating the runes before killing the marked target completes the harvest vow.

inventory.name: Dried meat ration
inventory.lore: Cured by Rurik from the meat of stray dogs and unwanted village livestock, he eats a piece every evening to remind himself of the butcher's lessons that all flesh is equal.
inventory.description: Tough, chewy strips of dried meat, salted heavily to preserve them.

inventory.name: 50 ft hemp rope
inventory.lore: Smeared with rendered beef fat to silence it, this rope has been used to bind every one of Rurik's victims in the abandoned village slaughterhouse before the ritual.
inventory.description: Coarse hempen rope, stained dark with grease and old blood.

inventory.name: Brass tinderbox
inventory.lore: A gift from the village blacksmith, who praises Rurik as the most helpful young man in the village for always bringing him free cuts of meat.
inventory.description: Small, polished brass tinderbox with a flint and steel striker inside.
inventory.effects: Can be used to light a torch or small fire in one action.

inventory.name: Carved wooden pig trinket
inventory.lore: Whittled by the old butcher for Rurik when he was seven years old, he rubs it between his fingers before every hunt to calm his nerves.
inventory.description: A small, crudely carved wooden pig, worn smooth from years of being rubbed between Rurik's fingers.

inventory.name: Coarse wool neighbor's cloak
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
